episodes.title: There's No Such Thing as Fate. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: Days after a heart-fluttering encounter with a charming man, Yu Na Bi bumps into him again. This time, she's formally introduced to Park Jae Eon.

episodes.title: It's Not Only Me. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: As Na Bi wonders whether Jae Eon only acts friendly toward her or also to other girls, she has a racy dream about the two of them in bed.

episodes.title: It has already begun. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: A cold, some jealousy and a slight misunderstanding drive Na-bi and Jae-eon further apart before bringing them closer than ever before.

episodes.title: I Know It Isn't Love. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: Na-bi's attraction to Jae-eon is enough to momentarily quiet her concerns about their intimate relationship - until a rude awakening sets in.

episodes.title: I Know Nothing Will Change. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: Sick of Jaae-eon's ways, Na-bi ends things with him. Oh Bit-na makes a drunken confession. Yun Seol-a approaches Na-bi on campus.

episodes.title: There's No Such Thing As Love. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: Na-bi visits her hometown, where she sleeps out in her aunt's studio and enjoys the outdoors with Yang Do-hyeok. Jae-eon feels Na-bi's absence.

episodes.title: I Know There's No Turning Back. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: The students arrive at the guesthouse for a group retreat. Na-bi tries to keep a distance from Jae-eon, who keeps his eye on her and Do-hyeok.

episodes.title: I Know It's a Lie. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: Do-hyeok surprises his childhood crush with a sweet confession. Na-bi visits a gallery with Jae-eon. Yun Sol gets honest about her feelings for Seo Ji-wan.

episodes.title: I Know It's over. Nevertheless,
episodes.summary: Afraid to lose Na-bi, Do-hyeok shows up in front of her building -only to see Jae-eon by her side. Sol allays Ji-wan's fears about their relationship.

episodes.title: Nevertheless, I still...
episodes.summary: Na-bi scrambles to recreate her sculpture days before the exhibit. Staying true to his word, Jae-eon bids farewell to his butterflies.
